dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: *sigh* How did this happen...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is something wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: Oh, what would it be if not the problem with the Blackcliff Forge? Things were going so well for us, too. Ore production was high and workplace accidents were low.

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: But a band of monsters suddenly came out of nowhere and took over one of our work sites.

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: The Millelith tried to give them the boot many times, but they returned with greater numbers every single time.

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: To ensure the workers' safety, I had to pull everyone back from the area.

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: But if that site is down, the production pressures on the others go up. This could throw the whole Forge's production schedules into disarray!

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: And I would go myself to investigate, but I dare not leave my daughter here or bring her along...

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: If you would, Traveler, could you go to that worksite and help me check it out?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: Thanks. I'll be waiting for you here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Allow me.

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: Thank you very much. I'll be waiting for you here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Work at the Blackcliff Forge has been stopped?

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: It has. The order for us to cease work was sent directly from the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: How could they just stop work at the drop of a hat like that? How will everyone get by? And we need their approval to resume work as well... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: Please, help me to investigate the area around the Chasm.

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: Manager Kuan! I want to buy a kite!

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: How many times do I have to tell you, just call me "Daddy." Now, if you study hard, Daddy will buy you one, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: No! Aren't you the shift supervisor of the Blackcliff Forge, Manager Kuan? As the supervisor, it's up to you to set an example.

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: But Daddy has to work, and you have to study. These are two completely differ—

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: Then let's talk about work! "Let our actions be recognized by hard work. Let our achievements be what speaks first." Isn't that right?

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: That's right, that's the Blackcliff Forge motto... How'd you remember that so clearly?

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: So let's start from your actions. If you buy me the kite, Manager Kuan, then I will recognize your hard work!

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: How many times do I have to say it — I'm "Daddy"! And how did this suddenly become about me? It's like you're trapping me in...

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: You're the one that started talking about work, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: *sigh* Alright, then. I'll buy you a kite. But from now on, you must call me "Daddy."

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: Alright, "Daddy"! Now, Daddy! Do as you promised!
